snapshot.title: Gate mission acceptance on cargo capacity
snapshot.description: Rocket and room doc specifies: if a mission requires more cargo than the rocket can carry, the player is shown why they cannot accept the mission. Entry point: LaunchpadSelectorPanel.gd contractor/mission selection.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Missions requiring more cargo than current rocket capacity are shown as unavailable
Disabled missions show tooltip: 'Cargo capacity insufficient — upgrade your Cargo Bay'
Cargo capacity from RocketSpecs is used for comparison (not a hardcoded value)

changes.newValue: LaunchpadSelectorPanel.gd: _render_trip_contract_brief now accepts rocket_id param (passed from awaiting_rocket_id). Computes required_kg from requested_minerals, max_haul_kg from cargo_multiplier * 2000 * 0.5. If required > max, shows amber warning label with specific numbers and upgrade hint.
